sentences.text: Hungary -LRB- -LSB- ˈhʌŋɡəri -RSB- Magyarország -LSB- ˈmɒɟɒrorsaːɡ -RSB- -RRB- is a unitary parliamentary republic in Central Europe .	parliamentary	Parliamentary system	unitary	Unitary state	parliamentary republic	parliamentary republic	Central Europe	Central Europe

It covers an area of 93,030 km2 , situated in the Carpathian Basin , and is bordered by Slovakia to the north , Romania to the east , Serbia to the south , Croatia to the southwest , Slovenia to the west , Austria to the northwest , and Ukraine to the northeast .	Carpathian Basin	Pannonian Basin	Slovakia	Slovakia	Romania	Romania	Serbia	Serbia	Croatia	Croatia	Slovenia	Slovenia	Austria	Austrian Empire	Ukraine	Ukraine
With about 10 million inhabitants , Hungary is a medium-sized member state of the European Union .	European Union	European Union	medium-sized member state	Member state of the European Union
The official language is Hungarian , which is the most widely spoken non-Indo-European language in Europe .	Hungarian	Hungarians	official language	Languages of Hungary

Hungary 's capital and largest metropolis is Budapest , a significant economic hub , classified as a global city .	Budapest	Budapest	largest metropolis	List of cities and towns of Hungary	global city	global city
Major urban areas include Debrecen , Szeged , Miskolc , Pécs and Győr .	Debrecen	Debrecen	Szeged	Szeged	Miskolc	Miskolc	Pécs	Pécs	Győr	Győr

Following centuries of successive habitation by Celts , Romans , Slavs , Gepids and Avars , the foundation of Hungary was laid in the late 9th century by the Hungarian grand prince Árpád in the conquest of the Carpathian Basin .	Hungarian	Hungarians	Carpathian Basin	Pannonian Basin	Celts	Celts	Romans	Ancient Rome	Slavs	Slavs	Gepids	Gepids	Avars	Avars (Carpathians)	Árpád	Árpád	conquest of the Carpathian Basin	Hungarian conquest of the Carpathian Basin
His great-grandson Stephen I ascended to the throne in 1000 , converting the country to a Christian kingdom .	Stephen I	Stephen I of Hungary	Christian kingdom	Kingdom of Hungary

By the 12th century , Hungary became a middle power within the Western world , reaching a golden age by the 15th century .	golden age by the 15th century	History of Hungary#Age of early absolutism	middle power	middle power

Following the Battle of Mohács in 1526 and about 150 years of partial Ottoman occupation -LRB- 1541 -- 1699 -RRB- , Hungary came under Habsburg rule , and later formed the great power Austro -- Hungarian Empire together with Austria .	Hungarian	Hungarians	Battle of Mohács	Battle of Mohács	Austria	Austrian Empire	Ottoman occupation	Ottoman Hungary	Habsburg rule	Habsburg Empire	great power	great power

Hungary 's current borders were established in 1920 by the Treaty of Trianon after World War I , when the country lost 71 % of its territory , 58 % of its population , and 32 % of ethnic Hungarians .	Hungarians	Hungarians	Treaty of Trianon	Treaty of Trianon	World War I	World War I

Following the interwar period , Hungary joined the Axis Powers in World War II , suffering significant damage and casualties .	interwar period	Hungary between the World Wars	Axis Powers	Axis Powers	World War II	World War II

Hungary became a satellite state of the Soviet Union , which contributed to the establishment of a four-decade-long communist dictatorship -LRB- 1947 -- 1989 -RRB- .	Soviet Union	Soviet Union	four-decade-long communist dictatorship	Hungarian People's Republic

The country gained widespread international attention regarding the Revolution of 1956 and the seminal opening of its previously-restricted border with Austria in 1989 , which accelerated the collapse of the Eastern Bloc .	Austria	Austrian Empire	Revolution of 1956	Hungarian Revolution of 1956	opening of its previously-restricted border with Austria in 1989	End of Communism in Hungary (1989)#Attitudes toward the Warsaw Pact	Eastern Bloc	Eastern Bloc
On 23 October 1989 , Hungary again became a democratic parliamentary republic .	parliamentary	Parliamentary system	parliamentary republic	parliamentary republic	democratic	Democracy

In the 21st century , Hungary is a middle power and has the world 's 57th largest economy by nominal GDP , as well as the 58th largest by PPP , out of 188 countries measured by the IMF .	middle power	middle power	57th largest economy by nominal GDP	List of countries by GDP (nominal)	58th largest by PPP	List of countries by GDP (PPP)	IMF	IMF

As a substantial actor in several industrial and technological sectors , it is both the world 's 36th largest exporter and importer of goods .	36th largest exporter	List of countries by exports	importer	List of countries by imports
Hungary is a high-income economy with a very high standard of living .	high-income economy	World Bank high-income economy	very high standard of living	List of countries by Human Development Index

It keeps up a social security and universal health care system , and a tuition-free university education .	social security	social security	universal health care	Healthcare in Hungary	university education	List of universities in Hungary

Hungary performs well in international rankings : it is 20th in quality of life , 25th in inequality-adjusted human development , 32nd in the Social Progress Index , and ranks as the 19th safest country in the world .	international rankings	International rankings of Hungary	quality of life	quality of life	inequality-adjusted human development	List of countries by inequality-adjusted HDI	Social Progress Index	Social Progress Index	19th safest country	Global Peace Index
Hungary joined the European Union in 2004 and has been part of the Schengen Area since 2007 .	European Union	European Union	Schengen Area	Schengen Area

Hungary is a member of the United Nations , NATO , WTO , World Bank , the AIIB , the Council of Europe and Visegrád Group .	United Nations	United Nations	NATO	NATO	WTO	WTO	World Bank	World Bank	AIIB	Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank	Council of Europe	Council of Europe	Visegrád Group	Visegrád Group

Hungary is the 11th most popular country as a tourist destination in Europe , attracting 14.3 million international tourists in 2015 .	11th most popular	World Tourism rankings	tourist destination	Tourism in Hungary

It is home to the largest thermal water cave system , the second largest thermal lake in the world , the largest lake in Central Europe , and the largest natural grasslands in Europe .
